item.title: Notify NYC - Bike MS: New York City 2026 - 10/18 (NYC)
item.description:
Notification issued 10-17-2026 at 03:00 PM.
In support of Bike MS: New York City 2026, there will be numerous street closures around the outer edge of Manhattan from approximately 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM tomorrow, 10/18. The race will start and finish at Pier 76 in Manhattan. There will be rolling street closures of the West Side Highway, FDR Drive, Harlem River Drive, Henry Hudson Parkway, Hugh L. Carey Tunnel, Henry Hudson Bridge, Robert F. Kennedy Bridge, and George Washington Bridge.
For more information, please visit: https://bit.ly/BikeMS26
